product_title: Davison Guitars Full Size Electric Guitar with 10-Watt Amp, Black - Right Handed Beginner Kit with Gig Bag and Accessories
description: If you're searching for the perfect 6-string electric guitar with a full range of accessories for a student, beginner, intermediate, or advanced guitar player, the Davison full-size electric guitar is an outstanding choice. Sold as a complete kit with all of the accessories, this guitar package offers excellent quality at a very attractive price. This guitar from Davison is a 39" solid body electric guitar. It features a flawless glossy finish, a maple neck with a finely finished fretboard, nickel frets, an adjustable chrome bridge, and six steel strings. It has a humbucker pickup for that rock sound, as well as two controls - one for tone, one for volume. Because it comes as a fully-equipped package, this guitar includes a 10 watt electric guitar amp with built-in overdrive and distortion, perfect for practice, playing at home, or warmups. Everything you need is included in this beginner guitar package, a padded gig bag with backpack straps, shoulder strap, cable, and three picks in assorted colors. Whether you are looking to purchase a solid body electric guitar beginner starter pack for yourself, a student, or as a gift, this is an excellent choice for both quality and price.

Full size electric guitar: Davison's stunning full-size 39" electric guitar features a sturdy, solid body and exquisite details that make it ideal for students, beginners, and guitar players at every level.

10W Amplifier included: Included with this electric guitar is a 10-watt guitar amplifier with built-in overdrive and distortion. This 10W amp is an excellent value, allowing you to practice almost anywhere with convenience.

Excellent quality: Built for years of musical enjoyment at a great price! This electric guitar features a classic, 6-string configuration, maple neck with a finely finished fretboard, nickel frets, and an adjustable chrome bridge. Designed with a humbucker pickup for that rock and roll sound and includes two controls, one for tone and one for volume.

This is really a beautiful guitar at a really great price, which is what Davison is all about. I received it in a few days, just like I was told. I took it out of the box, set it up to play and nothing. A ftre looking for a few ninutes I found that when the amp was packed, they shoved the plug inside the cabinet in back and it knocked one of the wires off the speaker. I hooked it back up and was back in business, at least I thought I was. When the amp was turned on, I started to get the humm or buzz others had written about in their reviews. After spending a few minutes checking the amp and its connections, I started looking at the guitar itself. I found that where that end of the strings pass thru the bridge was so poorly adjusted that some of the strings were actually touching the pickups. Then looking at the pickup, it was all crooked. One side was adjusted so high that the adjuster screw would turn and not adjust the height. The pickup had to come out and get put back together the right way and adjusted when reinstalled. All together, it's a great deal and an absolutely beautiful guitar, Davison just needs to improve their Quality Control at the factory level to eliminate these small issues.

product_title: Crescent MG38-CF 38" Acoustic Guitar Starter Package, COFFEE (Includes CrescentTM Digital E-Tuner)
description: Guitar is 38 inches in length and come with Steel Strings. The guitar has Linden Binding and wood construction with geared tuning. Each guitar comes with an extra set of steel strings, pick, tuner, gig bag and strap. The Steel String Acoustic Guitar is perhaps the most versatile and common guitar type. The Steel String Acoustic Guitar has a loud, bright ringing tone that clearly projects to the listener. This type of guitar is the backbone of most country and bluegrass bands. It’s perfect for backing a singer and its stylistic palette encompasses everything from New Age and Country Blues, to hot Bluegrass flatpicking, jazz fusion and “unplugged” rock. Tuning Pegs are made of Brass and Steel for easy tuning and to keep the tuned string held in position.
features: Linden Binding and Wood Construction with Geared Tuning
Set Includes: Full Set of Extra Strings, Gig Bag, Carrying Strap, Guitar Pick, Pick Guard, Pitch Pipe Tuner

positive_reviews: Very good guitar and was exactly as was claimed on the site (actually better than I thought it would be). The packing was excellent with no impact and delivery on time. All in all, I am very happy with the purchase and the service.
Great guitar for the price and purpose. Got it for my daughter who is 9 and she loves it. Now I've got to order a second one for her sister :)
Look, I paid $23 dollars for this so all I can say is great, however I would not pay more that $50 for this if it wasn't on sale.
great guitar/fast ship too
They called and apologized, explaining how the mix up happened.  It is a great guitar at a really inexpensive price. I recommend it.

the shape and condition my instrument came in was great. the guitar was reasonable for the price. i didnt recieve all the pieces but when i called they said they would delivered it to me which in a couple of days they did. as an overall i was pleased with my purchased

WELL IT TOOK FOREVER TO TUNE BUT THAT IS MY OWN FAULT BUT THE GUITAR ITSLEF IS BEAUTIFUL IT IS GLOSSY THE STRING ARE GOOD AND THE OMITTED SOUND IS MAGICAL..... GREAT BEGINNER GUITAR AND FOR THE PRICE IT IS AMAZING

This was received just as advertised. I was a little apprehensive after reading some reviews about this product. The instrument plays well when tuned correctly and this seller in particular got the item shipped out quickly. Thanks.
I placed my order and received it in two days Up to my door step no problem. Everything intact and as the  description Says...

This is a really good cheap guitar. I was looking for something more than a toy my daughter could learn to play on without spending too much. This worked great. My only probably was the shipping took forever and I had to email them for the tracking info.
negative_reviews: Seemed like it would be a good starter guitar for our 10 year old but after 2 months of lessons her teacher said it still won't stay tuned and the pitch doesn't sound right. We were just going to send it back but I see we missed the window by a couple of weeks. I was thinking we had 2 months and was giving it some time to see if it would work but it's not going to so we are now stuck with this and need to purchase a new one. Also when we first got it, the smell of the stain was really strong. Not what I would expect and the case it came with ripped right away so we had to buy a new one.

One of two guitars I purchased online for my daughters. They both had been playing for several weeks and I just wanted to get something cheap until I was sure they were into this for the long haul. This was originally intended for my oldest daughter, who isn't real picky, but she wasn't happy with the sound of it. When the second one came, she liked the appearance of it and asked her sister if she could have that one, instead. Her sister agreed, with hopes we could return this one. Paying the shipping just made it a deal breaker. Both girls agree the sound of this instrument stinks -- very tinny, strings are poor quality, uses cheap wood in the construction ... I could go on. We're keeping it in case anyone we know has a kid who would like to use it when starting out. It wouldn't even be in the house any more if we didn't have to pay shipping to return, though.

AGAIN BUYER BEWARE !!!!!
This is the worst guitar ever! Its a total waste of money!
This guitar will be shipped to you with blemishes and minor dents
This guitar will have a horrible chemical smell
The picks,strings,strap,case are totally useless
This guitar cannot hold a tune
Even if you buy excellent guitar string Brand like DDario guess what this guitar can't hold it
Please please please trust me on this don't buy this guitar
They ship you this guitar with cheep steel strings when in reality this os supposed to be a classical guitar.
It sucks.

If you want to buy an excellent outstanding economical guitar then I suggest you purchase one by the company Stagg.

I have purchased my classical guitar there and I love it to death. The sound quality makes me feel like its an extasy.

I really wish I could give this product Zero stars. Its a piece of junk don't buy it. I fell into the trap of buying this for my nephew and since i t couldn't be tuned properly my nephew got discouraged from playing it and I got discouraged from tuning it anymore.

I smashed this guitar to bits. Its a piece of junk. Go with Stagg or Fender. Don't go with Crescent.

I would also like to say that this is an honest review from a real customer. Please take my advice. I have been playing music for 6 Years now so I know what I am talking about. READ THE OTHER NEGATIVE REVIEWS FOR THIS PRODUCT ON AMAZON AND YOU WILL SEE WHAT I AM SAYING IS THE GOD HONEST TRUTH.
It was the worst. My son was disappointed because it came very out of tune and no amount of tuning helped. I just brought another one!
Price was good but when the item came the box was intact but the guitar was damaged.  Had to return.  Return shipping was free

I ordered this not expecting much. I didn't want to spend a lot of money on a guitar if I would not actually start practicing it. So I decided to get the cheap one and see if I do my daily practice. If I did, then I would upgrade to a more expensive model. The guitar came opened without any of the accessories. It was okay for the price as far as the guitar, but a tuner and pick are necessary to start practicing. I immediately called my favorite people at Amazon, who contacted the company and issued me a credit for the inconvenience. The company has sent me the accessory kit so we shall see if it has everything advertised. I understand that at 19.99 you are buying a low end cheap guitar. But if you say it comes with accessories make sure you ship them. Otherwise do not sell on Amazon!!! If it were not for Amazon, I would give this product 0 stars. I think that Amazon is the best company for ensuring Customer Satisfaction. This why I remain a loyal customer for over 14 years.
Unfortunately, it didn't fit my child. Didn't keep it for very long. The return was quick, and they had excellent communication and were easy to deal with. Great customer service.

So you are looking for a low cost beginner guitar, right? Well don't click "Add to cart" until you read this. I bought this guitar in mid-November it was three days late and arrived on December 12th. I wanted a cheap guitar to learn on before investing in a name brand. Huge mistake. First, this guitar is cheaply made like on a slightly ridiculous level. The bridge is plastic, the guitar smells of chemicals (most likely the particle board this thing is made of or the cheap finish) It didn't even come in the color I requested. I attempted to tune it and a string snaps, well I used the replacement it comes with and to my surprise that one snapped as well. Finally get a string set and tune the guitar. However, the bridge started to come off the guitar as its a plastic piece that has been superglued. Five minutes in and the guitar is drastically out of tune. I contacted the seller and surprisingly they answer promptly and have offered a refund. Save your self a massive headache and disappointment and look elsewhere. I found a Rogue guitar on Amazon for $10 more, name brand, and many positive reviews. Don't waste your money on this junk. I will end with saying that I am glad the seller responded in a quickly manner.

EDIT: The seller wants me to pay to ship the guitar back. The shipping cost exceeds the cost of the guitar. LOL. After many disputes Amazon foot the bill and gave a me a full refund. I got to keep the guitar but honestly it's junk taking up space. In the trash it goes.
Unusable, unsellable.

Package was damaged. Strings broke upon first attempt to tune. Product description led me believe this was a guitar suitable for a novice adult. This is a guitar for a child. I bought this for my dear friend as a gift. He's in his mid 20s. I would have been just a well off giving him a toy guitar. Don't wast your time with this product. Also, $40 was such an markup compared to the $17 tag it carries now. Morally ambiguous dealer + severe overcharge + poor quality = unhappy customer. Not a satisfied customer.

positive_reviews: I bought this for my 9 year old.  She loves it and is now taking lessons.  One string did pop during tuning, so we had to go get it fixed, but it is otherwise sturdy, small enough for her to hold, and a lot of fun!
the product the guitar is right handed. but i'm a left handed player.i love that the saddle was easy to change. the sound is regular but sounds perfect. I love this guitar.

I think it is a great buy for a beginner guitar. It was a nice quality for the price and the sound was good. If there was one thing I could suggest is that it come with instructions. There are stickers to use as a pick guard but I didn't know quite where to put them. And I didn't know how or where to put the one end of the strap to the guitar. I just tied it to the end and tried not to interfere with the pegs or strings. Other than that, my niece loved it and felt like Taylor Swift.

We bought this for our preteen son, who just started guitar.  We changed the strings to nylon--it plays great!  Our nine-year daughter got hers in purple, which looks so cool!  Overall, we are very happy with our purchase!

This guitar is amazing for the price. I have had it for a month and no strings have broken, and for the most part it stays in tune. This guitar is a great deal and better quality than a first act guitar I used to own. well worth it.

This was a great bargain! And we receiced it SUPER fast! Overall, very pleased with this purchase. Would have given 5 stars, except it didn't come *exactly* as advertised. In the ad it states it comes with a full set of extra strings. Ours came with only *one* string. LOL Not worth making a stink about, because we can pick them up pretty inexpensively. Otherwise, the guitar is beautiful, well constructed and was a GREAT price for what we received and shipping was very fast.
Great for someone just learning.  My grandson liked it a lot.  The only problem was that the bag for it was really cheap and all the zippers were all broken.
This was a great gift. However, during the tuning there were some issues with one of the strings. It had to be replaced before it could be used.

I got this guitar for my own birthday. This is the first time I play a guitar so I wanted something cheap but good too. I got the guitar on time with everything they specified (pipe tuner, pick, bag etc...)
about 3days after I bought it, i was tuning it. and the 3rd string popped. That is probably, partly due to my lack of experience, but the strings were cheap too. No big deal, I bought new strings and they sound much better. Apart from that this is an excellent guitar

Perfect guitar for a beginner & great price. The color & finish on it makes it look more expensive than it is. We did re-string it & purchase a different tuner for it because my husband kept breaking the strings! My daughter loves it & said it reminds her of Taylor Swift's guitar, which in her eyes is a definite plus!
negative_reviews: Bridge broke off shortly after gifting.
This guitar's strings were flimsy, especially the last one. I tightened them and all but still was not getting good sound quality. I have owned guitars previously but this one was by far the worst.

This is a bad guitar even if you just consider it a child's guitar. The wood, if you can call it that, is very cheap. The one I got had steel strings on it and it is a classical nylon sting body. The steel strings put so much tension of the bridge it nearly tore off of the body. If you are going to get this I suggest re-stringing it with nylon strings the first day before you even strum it. I also suggest buying a real case or gig bag because the one that comes with it is crap with no padding at all. The extra stings that comes with it are useless because they are for a steel string guitar, the tuner is OK, the pitch pipe is OK, and the picks are good beginner picks.

Guitar sounded so bad and wouldn't tune, that I thought better strings might help, so I purchased good quality steel strings because the guitar came with steel strings on it. In my research on changing strings, I learned this guitar should have nylon ones, like a classical guitar. Not steel. You can tell by the way the strings attach at the head and at the bridge. It is different than a steel-string acoustic guitar. In the end, I'm not sure the correct strings will make this guitar worth bothering with, but I hope it will. Might be worth a few bucks for a set of nylon strings to experiment. I was trying to make something worth playing from a cheap guitar my son purchased, because I like the smaller size of it.

My daughter was so excited by this gift. But a string broke and when I took it to the guitar center found out it was incorrectly strung with steel strings (should be nylon).  The total fix,  $38 almost the guitar cost. Beware.
I agree its cheap, however the guitar doesn't tune well nor does it have good quality strings. I had 2 strings that broke in 2 days.
I just received this guitar and it is very cheap, I started tightening the strings and i wasn't even half way and the wood holding the strings down broke and it is ruined.. Very disappointed
I was very disappointed. The guitar had scuffs on it and it has a very loose hold on the strings and it doesn't stay intune long.
good for a kid needs nylon strings

It looks good at first appearance but as soon as my son tried to tune it, the string fell off at the top and bottom.

If it fell off at first try, then we didn't want to keep it for fear it or another string would fall off too.

It's more flimsy than we thought it would be.

It's too bad because it looked like a good deal.

positive_reviews: slight cracking around the neck. could have been caused in shipping.  standard and mass produced.  nice looking and sound is good as well.  pitch pipe helps the tuning and fits great into nylon case.

Very nice! I got this as my first guitar, and its very nice! It holds a tune very, very well. One thing, though, is the 4th string (third from top) has a bit of a springy sound. By that, I mean it has a bit of rattle if you use the 4th or 5th fret.
Was  gift for an avid musician and she was impressed with the sound that is generates. easy to tune and now I enjoy the music made from the front row :)
it's very good for the price... and you just have to find a way to adjust the sound...any way good product.

I ordered 2 of the same guitar on different dates.  The 1st one was fine but I need to return the 2nd one because my son said it seems like the neck isn't straight and a couple of the wires don't work well.  The 1st one worked fine.
negative_reviews:
I got this for someone as a gift so they can learn to play guitar and it was cheap. And when we got it... yeah it was cheap. The frets are sharp at the edges and if you have not played guitar before that is a terrible thing. When you move your had down the neck they scrape your fingers and they get raw fast! The fret board smelt like cheap paint and it looked like it as well. The body feels semi solid and ok, but the tuning keys are terrible and will not hold a tune even with extra lite gauge strings.

If you do not know how to file frets, set the action on a guitar, or replace tuning keys I would stay very far away from this guitar. If you know how to do those things, then you know this isn't a good value. Spend the extra money and get a Takemine Jasmine they cost around $90 and are great.

This guitar is not all it says it is. I just took mine to Guitar Center and he said it is junk! The bridge part is coming off the body of the guitar, and it is a CLASSICAL guitar which is meant for NYLON strings, NOT STEEL. Steel strings are for a basic acoustic guitar. This is not sold properly, and the guitar has the wrong strings. I say to all of you, don't buy! Get a good guitar. You do get what you pay for!

Ordered this as a Christmas present for my 9 year old grandson. First off the strings were terrible quality.
Then the first fret was so high that the strings were touching it. This caused them to sound terrible and buzz. It was totally unplayable. Luckily I'm a guitarist and was able to break the platic nut loose and raise it up to stop the strings from buzzing . But it still sounds like crap. Totally a waste of mopney. DO NOT BUY THIS PIECE OF JUNK.
Fretboard is loose screws pulling out from body.  Not a bit happy, let's see how return goes.  Really not happy.

I didn't expect much when I bought a $40 guitar, but I at least expected it to be functional. The bridge at the bottom of the guitar where the bottom of the strings rest was placed on the guitar completely crooked, and as such, the strings react completely different from one another when you push them against the frets, making this guitar completely impossible to play.

Don't waste your money.

NO Truss rod, No Fret Markers,Nut and Bridge was junk, Finish was like it was done outside in a sandstorm,Only after replacing the nut,Bridge,strings,Filing the frets, Did it even sound like a guitar able for a student, If you think this is a good deal, Sorry to say it's NOT.

When buying this item, I understood that it was not very expensive, and that quality and price are normally related. However, when we buy items of any price in this country we expect at the least, minimal standards. Simply put, that equates to the item doing what it was designed to do. This instrument could not even be tuned to 4/40 which is a standard tuning for most guitars. The neck was so weak I was afraid to continue turning the tuning machines...I broke one of the attached strings trying to tune the guitar...and the neck continued to bow...thats not minimal standard.
